description: A token with an empty value is a token, so it stands between `a` and B (engine §4.2 and §6, case 67).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item w | c
%rule w "a" :: A | "b" :: B
%emits $
%rule c ","
%emits $ :: C := ""
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text a [C] B
%rule a A
%conditions ¬$.followed-by(B)
```
